_note: ABS Originals: the animated animal series (hand-edited). Episodes come from data/show-episodes.json, written by scripts/shows/sync-shows.mjs from the Shorts workspace. Characters link to their animal pages by slug; keep blurbs spoiler-free.

brand.name: ABS Originals
brand.about: ABS Originals are short animated drama series from Animal Battle Stats. Every character is a real animal with a real stat card on this site, and every episode is about a minute long, told like a TV show: a story in order, a cliffhanger at the end, and the answer in the next episode.

shows.name: BREAKOUT
shows.title: Breakout
shows.logline: Ken, an orangutan who plans everything, gets himself locked up on purpose to break his big brother Bruno out before the transfer to Max, the prison nobody comes back from. Seven days, one warden with a secret, and a raccoon who knows more than he says.

characters.name: Ken
characters.blurb: Plans everything, trusts no one, and has seven days to get his brother out.

characters.name: Bruno
characters.blurb: Ken's big brother, days away from the transfer to Max.

characters.name: The raccoon
characters.blurb: Knows every lock in the building. Says as little as possible.

characters.name: Marco
characters.blurb: Six years in the next cell over. Worries out loud, loyal to the end.

characters.name: Warden Hollis
characters.blurb: Runs the prison, never raises his voice, and has never lost.

shows.name: DEDUCTION
shows.title: Deduction
shows.tagline: No badge. One case at a time.
shows.logline: Monty, a macaque with no badge who reads people, and Sergeant Rex, a police dog who just wants him not to do the thing, solve one impossible case at a time, until the cases start pointing back at Monty.

characters.name: Monty
characters.blurb: No badge, round glasses, and he reads people like a book.

characters.name: Sgt. Rex
characters.blurb: City police. Honest, tired, and always one step behind Monty.

characters.name: Bernie
characters.blurb: Swears he never left his desk the night the diamond vanished.

characters.name: Sterling
characters.blurb: Runs the city museum. Precise, polite and a little too calm.

shows.name: FASTEST
shows.title: Fastest
shows.logline: Gerald was just the tallest guy on the savanna until a lightning strike made him the fastest animal alive. Now the cheetah wants a race, his muscles have a limit, and a fire is coming across the plain.

characters.name: Gerald
characters.blurb: Tallest on the savanna, and since the lightning, the fastest too.

characters.name: The cheetah
characters.blurb: Nobody has ever beaten him. Nobody has ever even tried.

characters.name: Doc
characters.blurb: The slowest animal on the show times the fastest one.
